messages:
aj: FYI — onboarding goliath-13b-int8 on dedicated cluster. Observed token drift after ~18k tokens when switching from cached prefix to live generation. Repro steps and logs below.

emily: hmm. Is that the rot-phase scaling we saw last week? :thinking:

aj: Possibly. Test summary: same prompt, run A (prefill warmhead + cached KV), run B (no prefill), outputs diverge at step ~18003. Logs show cache indices match, but attention weights differ.

quentin: can you paste the command and the seed? also which kernel/quant build?

aj: Command:
```
run_eval --model goliath-13b-int8 --seed 42 --max-tokens 20000 --prefill-mode cached --quant int8-v2 --kernel fused-attn
```
Build: release/opt/quant-int8-2026-03

dan: did you try force-rope-rescale flag? last time rope mismatch was fixed by applying the new rescale table.

aj: Not yet. Quick diff of logits between A/B (first mismatch):
```
index 18003: A= -3.1421, B= -2.9875, delta= -0.1546
```

sara: If indices match but weights differ maybe the KV index handshake dropped one token during shard-merge. Any shard-swap in logs?

aj: There is a short reassign event at t=00:03:14 from scheduler: "shard 3 -> 1" (see deploy log). Perf-bot: can you attach the trace?

perf-bot: trace attached (job 3741592653). Latency spike at 00:03:14 aligned with shard migration, GC on device 2 :boom:

emily: OK that points to in-flight KV eviction. Can we rerun with --pin-shards and --kv-sync-check to confirm?

aj: queued a run with --pin-shards --kv-sync-check --rope-rescale=auto. will report.

quentin: also try running short prefix (<=8k) to see if reproducible. If not, likely a late-handshake race when context >16k.

aj: re-run done. With pin-shards + kv-sync-check the divergence disappears. With pin-shards only it still reproduces. So kv-sync-check matters.

dan: then we should add a lightweight invariant check in KV handshake: checksum of prefill sequence before/after migration. File an issue?

sara: filing: GH#ml/kv-handshake-checksum

aj: thanks. Action items: (1) add checksum guard (2) add test in nightly for longctx handoff (3) include rope-rescale opt in quant onboarding docs. I'll open PRs.

emily: nice catch. cc @eng-runtime for the shard migration policy.

aj: noting in runnotes: seed 42, build release/opt/quant-int8-2026-03, reproduces without kv-sync-check on shard-migration. end.
